dashboard.emptyRecommendation: Start by importing your résumé: every AI action will then use it automatically.
dashboard.noMatches: No jobs yet. Postings will appear here once job search is connected.
dashboard.nextTailor: Your résumé is ready. Add a posting to your applications to tailor your résumé and cover letter.
dashboard.interviewSoon: Interview {date} at {company}. Prepare your STAR answers from your résumé.

studio.title: AI Studio
studio.intro: Pick an action. Tremio fills in what it already knows from your profile and only asks for the rest.
studio.limit: You've reached today's generation limit. It resets in 24 hours.
studio.error: Generation failed. Try again in a moment.
studio.pasteJobHint: Paste the posting if it isn't in your applications yet.
studio.pageFetch: Couldn't read this page ({reason}). Paste its text into the field instead.

login.title: Sign in to Tremio
login.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a one-time sign-in code.
login.codeSent: A sign-in code was sent to {email}. Enter it below.

errors.send: Sending the code failed. Check the address and try again.
errors.code: Invalid or expired code. Check it or request a new one.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.

profile.title: Profile and résumé
profile.intro: Your résumé and profile feed every action in the AI Studio. You only enter them once.
profile.completionHint: Complete your profile for sharper cover letters and interview answers.
profile.completionDone: Your profile is complete. The AI Studio can use all of it.
profile.formats: PDF, Word (.docx) or text, 5 MB max.
profile.uploaded: Résumé imported. You can now fill in your profile from it.
profile.suggestNeedsResume: Import your résumé first to fill in your profile automatically.
profile.suggested: Suggestions added. Review them, then save.
profile.headline: Professional title
profile.identityHint: 2 or 3 sentences: what you do, for whom, and what sets you apart.

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.unsupported: Unsupported format. Use a PDF, .docx or .txt.
errors.empty: No text found in this file. If it's a scanned PDF, export your résumé from Word or Google Docs.
errors.unreadable: This file couldn't be read. Try another format.
errors.ai_unavailable: Résumé analysis failed. Try again in a moment.

profile.gender: French grammatical agreement in your documents
profile.genderHint: Only used to agree job titles and adjectives in your French résumés and letters. Never shown in your documents.
profile.contactTitle: Contact details shown on your résumés
profile.contactHint: They replace the ones in your imported résumé on every generated résumé. Handy to update a phone number without re-importing.

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.body: This section is coming in an upcoming sprint. Meanwhile, the AI Studio works with a pasted job posting.
soon.jobsBody: Automatic job search, with a match score for every posting, is coming in the next sprint. Meanwhile, add the postings you like to your applications.

applications.title: My applications
applications.intro: Drag a card to change its status. Each card suggests the next step.
applications.introEmpty: Add a posting you're interested in: you enter it once, then the AI Studio uses it for everything else.
applications.confirmDelete: Delete this application and its documents? This can't be undone.
applications.moveError: The status change wasn't saved. Reload the page.
applications.descriptionHint: Paste the full text: it's used to tailor your résumé, write the cover letter and prepare the interview.
applications.noDescription: Add the posting text in the details to unlock the actions that need it.
applications.noDocuments: No documents yet. After a generation, click “Save to application”.

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalid: Check the fields: the title is required and the link must be a valid web address.

applications.truncated: This posting only contains a truncated excerpt, so generated documents will be less precise. Open the full posting, copy its text, paste it into “Posting text”, then save.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.intro: Practice with questions tailored to each posting and to your résumé. Every answer is assessed with the STAR method.
interviews.emptyBody: When an application reaches the interview stage, move its card to the “Interview” column: it will show up here with its prep tools.
interviews.answerHint: Answer as you would out loud: the situation, your role, your actions and the result.
interviews.noAnswers: No answers were assessed in this session.
interviews.summaryGood: Great preparation. Reread the improved versions right before the interview.
interviews.summaryWork: Good foundation. Work mostly on quantified results, then run another session.

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.too_short: Your answer is too short to assess.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Search real postings across Canada. Each one gets a match score against your profile, explained by its strengths and gaps.
jobs.searchingHint: Fetching postings, then computing match scores. This can take about twenty seconds.
jobs.noneFound: No postings found. Try broader keywords or another city.
jobs.empty: Run a search to see postings ranked for your profile.
jobs.snippetNote: Adzuna only provides an excerpt of each posting. After adding one to your applications, paste the full text into it for sharper documents.

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.adzuna_not_configured: Job search isn't configured yet: add ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY to .env.local.
errors.adzuna_unauthorized: Adzuna rejected the credentials. Check ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY.
errors.adzuna_rate_limited: The Adzuna search limit has been reached. Try again later.
errors.adzuna_unavailable: Adzuna isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_profile: Postings saved, but they couldn't be scored: import your résumé or add your skills in Profile and résumé.
errors.ai_unavailable: Postings are saved, but scoring failed. Run the search again.

resumePdf.title: Tailored résumé (PDF)
resumePdf.intro: Tremio rewrites your résumé for this role using only your real experience, then lays it out to ATS standards: one column, standard fonts, text that recruiting software can read.
resumePdf.generatingHint: Tailoring the content and laying it out. This usually takes 20 to 40 seconds.
resumePdf.missingHint: They weren't added so nothing is made up. If you have these skills, add them to your source résumé, then regenerate.
resumePdf.genderHint: To get French job titles right (développeuse, développeur…), set your preference in your profile.

errors.no_description: Add the posting text in the application details to generate a tailored résumé.
errors.ai_unavailable: Writing the résumé failed. Try again in a moment.

resumePdf.formatsHint: Send the PDF. The Word version lets you fine-tune the text before exporting it to PDF yourself.

letter.title: Cover letter
letter.intro: A letter written for this role from your résumé and the posting: an opening about the company, two achievements that answer its needs, and a closing that proposes a meeting. Same header as your tailored résumé.
letter.notesPlaceholder: E.g. I already use their products, I can start right away, I was referred by…
